skillPoints.note: All 83 points are spent. The confirmed active skills are Whirlwind, War Cry, Challenging Shout, Rallying Cry, Wrath of the Berserker, and Iron Skin, plus the upgrades named on those skills. allocationVerified on a skill, and verified on an upgrade, confirm the allocation only. Numeric values stay unverified unless they already were. Flay is inactive. Every other non-passive skill and upgrade is inactive. passives is empty: no passive name is present in the sourced repo data, so none were added.
